# Variables and how to use them

Source: [wiki article 2080](../archive/2080.md); edited 2024-01-28.

<a id="wiki-2080-n1"></a>

- Documented state model has one game-wide instance of each global variable and separate instances of each player variable.

<a id="wiki-2080-n2"></a>

- Chasing at rate/over time supports numbers or vectors only; initial and destination types must match.

<a id="wiki-2080-n3"></a>

- Stop Chasing leaves a variable at its current value; over-time chase is documented to reach its destination within duration unless changed.

<a id="wiki-2080-n4"></a>

- Examples illustrate global shared destinations and per-player ability cooldown state; modify operations use existing value as first arithmetic operand and supplied value as second, or append/remove supplied array values.
